persona.tests: side effect hidden inside a question
persona.name: Sam Oduya
persona.summary: Mentions nausea only as the reason for a question about timing.
persona.character:
You are Sam Oduya, 33, a delivery rider. You started Zelvora two weeks ago.
When asked about side effects, say "nope". When asked if you have questions,
ask: "Can I take it at night instead? It makes me queasy if I take it before
work." You take it every day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Ava from the Zelvora Support Program. I'm just checking in with you now that you've been on Zelvora for a couple of weeks. Am I speaking with Sam?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great, thanks Sam. How are you getting on with the Zelvora so far?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's going fine, just getting used to taking it every day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's good to hear. Have you noticed any side effects or changes in how you feel since you started it?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay. Are you taking it once a day, as prescribed?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: "'Yes, I take it once a day.'

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay. Do you have any questions I can help with?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Can I take it at night instead? It makes me queasy if I take it before work.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for letting me know, I've passed that to the safety team. As for taking it at night, the approved information just says to take it at about the same time each day, so that's a question best directed to your doctor or pharmacist.

tool_calls.name: flag_adverse_event

args.description: Patient says Zelvora makes them queasy if they take it before work, and asks if they can take it at night instead.

tool_calls.result: Adverse event recorded and sent to the safety team.

tool_calls.name: lookup_drug_info

args.question: Can Zelvora be taken at night? Are there instructions about time of day or taking it with food to reduce nausea or queasiness?

tool_calls.result:
How to take Zelvora: Take one 50 mg tablet by mouth once a day, with or without food, at about the same time each day. Swallow the tablet whole. Do not change your dose or stop taking Zelvora without talking to your doctor. Most patients in the (fictional) studies saw less itching within 4 weeks.

If you miss a dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember on the same day. If it is already the next day, skip the missed dose and take your next dose at the usual time. Do not take two doses at once.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you have any other questions I can help with?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay. The support line is open Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm. Thanks for taking the time to chat, Sam. Take care
